criteria: E >= TG_min x measured cycle at the selected k (2.72 at k=4, 2.85 at k=5 for the 2026-10-24 cycle; recompute after R1 instead of hard-coding)
per-pass submit+sync < 1 ms, and the GPU leg within 10% of the roofline model at k=1/2/4/5/8
locality within 5 pp of M0 on non-technical text
two miss legs measured and the cycle recomputed with an adaptive split (RESULTS section 9)
VRAM budget closes at some (ctx, cache) point, or U-3 selects the fallback (RESULTS section 10)
decision_gate.on_fail: stop and ask the user: lower the TG target, change the ctx cost, or page the KV (design section 9)

targets.rule: 130/1000 are hard floors until the user re-sets them; the design target is 0.85 x the roofline at the binding leg, reported every round by R0

gpu.desc: dGPU and its VRAM: one process at a time

host-ram.desc: a resident 21.28 GiB model plus its KV/state: about 28 GiB free RAM

machine-quiet.desc: anything that perturbs timing or hogs cores: timed runs, full -j8 build, mem/disk probes, repack

disk-io.desc: more than 1 GiB of reads/writes, or any SSD bandwidth measurement

trace-bin.desc: regenerating a routing trace .bin; reading an existing one is shared

prompt-file.desc: editing a file under bench/prompts/; reading is shared

bench.desc: runs the model or measures the machine; strictly serialized, one agent, one process at a time

impl.desc: writes code and builds it; parallel across agents if paths are disjoint and no bench is running

data.desc: pure text and light CPU: prompts, vocab list, GGUF metadata, analysis, docs; never blocks anyone

io.desc: repack and large-file verification; exclusive with both bench and builds

user.desc: decisions only the user can make; an agent may prepare a one-page choice set, then stop

queues.head: R1
queues.note: R1 probes each leg against its hardware ceiling; M1-4b/M1-3b/M1-2b follow once impl/data deliver their inputs

queues.head: M1-4a
queues.note: M2-* and M3-* stay unassigned until gate M1 passes and U-3 is answered

queues.head: R0
queues.note: R0 turns the measured legs into the roofline model; M5-1 unblocks the io lane

queues.head: U-3
queues.note: U-3 (KV/ctx) blocks every M2 implementation task; U-1 is closed

escalations.question: 256K KV needs 5120-5632 MiB of the 7176 MiB usable VRAM, which is incompatible with any expert cache: reduce ctx, page KV to host, or quantize KV
escalations.note: M1-6 numbers in RESULTS section 10; 25% cache does not fit at any ctx, the feasible corner is ctx <= 16K with a 20% cache; the target workload (10K prompt) only needs 220 MiB resident
